message.text:
Focusing on which record types the store layer deletes before the memo row itself during API deletion.

In `store/memo.go`, `Store.DeleteMemo` deletes `memo_relation` records where this memo is the source or target, plus any linked `attachments`. Comment rows are handled by the API layer, not the store layer.

Reactions and memo_share records are not deleted by the store layer. Only memo_relations and attachments are removed before the memo row itself.

message.text:
`Store.DeleteMemo` in `store/memo.go` deletes `memo_relation` records and attachments linked to the memo before removing the memo row itself.

`memo_share` records are deleted by the database via ON DELETE CASCADE, not by the store layer. Reactions are not deleted by the store layer either.

q16.
memo_relation records (where the memo is source or target)
attachments linked to the memo

`Store.DeleteMemo` in `store/memo.go` removes those, then calls the dialect `DeleteMemo` that deletes the `memo` row. The API handler in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` deletes comment memos first, but that is not store-layer cleanup of the target memo. `memo_share` is only removed by `ON DELETE CASCADE` after the memo row is gone.
